title: Kinematics of Motion in a Straight Line Module 6 Lesson 2: Evaluate Velocity Displacement Integration custom practice

evidence_basis.originality_note: All prompts, numerical values and physical configurations are original; mapped Cambridge past-paper evidence informs cognitive demand and assessment structure only.

parts.prompt: A particle moves with velocity $v = 6t^2 - 10t + 3\text{ m s}^{-1}$. At $t = 0$, the particle is at $O$. Find its displacement when $t = 2\text{ s}$.
A particle moves with velocity $v = 15\sqrt{t} - 4t\text{ m s}^{-1}$ for $t \ge 0$. Find the displacement of the particle from $t = 0$ to $t = 4\text{ s}$.
A particle starts from rest at $t = 0$ and has acceleration $a = 6t^{1/2} + 2\text{ m s}^{-2}$. Find the speed of the particle when $t = 9\text{ s}$.

A particle starts from rest at $O$ at $t = 0$ with acceleration $a = 6\sqrt{t}\text{ m s}^{-2}$. Find the non-zero time $t$ at which the speed (in $\text{m s}^{-1}$) and the distance travelled from $O$ (in $\text{m}$) are numerically equal.

A particle moves with acceleration $a = 12 - 6t\text{ m s}^{-2}$. Given that the particle has velocity $v = 8\text{ m s}^{-1}$ at $t = 1\text{ s}$, find the velocity of the particle when $t = 3\text{ s}$.
A particle moves with velocity $v = 12t^{-1/2} + 3t^2\text{ m s}^{-1}$. Find the displacement of the particle from $t = 1\text{ s}$ to $t = 4\text{ s}$.

questions.prompt: A particle $P$ moves in a straight line starting from a point $O$ with initial velocity $2\text{ m s}^{-1}$. The acceleration of $P$ at time $t\text{ s}$ ($t \ge 0$) is given by $a = 0.6t^{1/2}\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the value of $t$ when the velocity of $P$ is $5.2\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the displacement of $P$ from $O$ when $t = 4\text{ s}$.

questions.prompt: A particle moves in a straight line, starting from rest from a fixed point $O$. Its velocity $v\text{ m s}^{-1}$ at time $t\text{ s}$ ($t \ge 0$) is given by $v = 3t^2 - 16t^{3/2} + 12t$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the displacement of the particle from $O$ when $t = 4\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the particle when $t = 1\text{ s}$, and state whether its speed is increasing or decreasing at this instant.

questions.prompt: A particle $P$ moves in a straight line. The acceleration $a\text{ m s}^{-2}$ of $P$ at time $t\text{ s}$ is given by $a = 6t - 18$. The displacement of $P$ from a fixed point $O$ on the line is $s\text{ m}$. It is given that $s = 21\text{ m}$ when $t = 1\text{ s}$ and $s = 23\text{ m}$ when $t = 3\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Show that $s = t^3 - 9t^2 + pt + q$, stating the values of the constants $p$ and $q$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the values of $t$ when $P$ is at instantaneous rest, and calculate the displacement of $P$ at each of these instants.

questions.prompt: A particle $P$ moves in a straight line starting from $O$. The acceleration of $P$ at time $t\text{ s}$ ($t \ge 0$) is given by $a = 8t + 4\text{ m s}^{-2}$. At $t = 1\text{ s}$, the velocity of $P$ is $10\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find expressions for the velocity $v$ and displacement $s$ of $P$ in terms of $t$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the instant when the acceleration of $P$ is $28\text{ m s}^{-2}$, and calculate the speed and displacement of $P$ at this instant.

questions.prompt:
An automated light-rail shuttle travels along a straight track between station $A$ and station $B$.
From $t = 0$ to $t = 6\text{ s}$, the acceleration of the shuttle is given by $a_1 = 3 - 0.5t\text{ m s}^{-2}$, starting from rest at $A$ ($s = 0$).
From $t = 6\text{ s}$ until it comes to rest at $B$, the shuttle undergoes constant deceleration of $1.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the maximum velocity of the shuttle during Stage 1 and its displacement at $t = 6\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Calculate the total time taken for the shuttle to travel from $A$ to $B$, and find the total distance between the two stations.

questions.prompt:
A particle $P$ moves in a straight line, starting from rest at a fixed point $O$ at $t = 0$. Its acceleration $a\text{ m s}^{-2}$ at time $t\text{ s}$ ($t \ge 0$) is given by:
$$a = 3t - 12t^{1/2} + 9$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find expressions for the velocity $v(t)$ and displacement $s(t)$ in terms of $t$, and show that the minimum velocity of $P$ is $-13.5\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the displacement of $P$ from $O$ at the instant of minimum velocity ($t = 9\text{ s}$), and calculate the displacement of $P$ from $O$ when $t = 4\text{ s}$.

questions.prompt:
Two particles, $P$ and $Q$, move along the same straight line from a fixed origin $O$.
Particle $P$ leaves $O$ at $t = 0$ with initial velocity $5\text{ m s}^{-1}$ and acceleration $a_P = 6 - 2t\text{ m s}^{-2}$.
Particle $Q$ leaves $O$ at $t = 2\text{ s}$ from rest and moves with acceleration $a_Q = 6t - 12\text{ m s}^{-2}$ for $t \ge 2$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Derive expressions for the velocity and displacement of both particles in terms of $t$ for $t \ge 2$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the velocities of both particles at $t = 4\text{ s}$, and calculate the distance between the two particles at this instant.
